backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, product CRUD, and sale recording with authorization checks using AccessControl and maps for storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app into the root container.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling authentication, onboarding, and routing between dashboard, products, sales, profile, and notifications pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button that triggers Internet Identity authentication and clears the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/DailyS: Displays four metric cards summarizing total sales, revenue, cost, and profit for the selected day.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/LowSto: Renders alerts for products below stock thresholds using user defaults or product overrides.
Layout wrapper providing header, sidebar navigation, and footer around app pages with responsive menu handling.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Dialog form to create or edit a product with validation and submit handling via product mutation hooks.
Displays a table of products with cost, pricing, stock info, low‑stock indicators, and edit/delete actions.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: Onboarding dialog for entering a user name and default stock threshold, saved via profile mutation.
frontend/src/components/sales/SaleForm.t: Form for recording a sale, validating quantity and pricing, calculating profit, and submitting a sale record.
frontend/src/components/sales/SalesHisto: Renders a sortable table of recorded sales with product names, totals, profit badges, and notes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to identity changes, invalidating dependent queries when updated.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboard.ts: Provides a hook that fetches sales for a selected day and computes totals for sales, revenue, cost, and profit.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider handling auth client creation, identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, products, sales, and low‑stock alerts via an actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Re-exports user profile query and mutation hooks for convenience.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining CSS variables for light and dark themes and applying global styles.
frontend/src/lib/format.ts: Utility functions for formatting currency, numbers, and dates from numeric or bigint values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the dashboard with date-based sales summary and low-stock alerts, including calendar filtering.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Displays notification settings UI with disabled WhatsApp integration features marked as coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/Products.tsx: Shows the product list with add, edit, and delete actions using product query and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileSettings.tsx: Renders a profile settings form that loads user data, validates input, and saves updates with success and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/Sales.tsx: Provides tabs for recording new sales and viewing sales history, loading sales data and displaying a form or table accordingly.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including hash-routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, layout, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing implemented features, architecture notes, and versioned capabilities for the app.
